dealId.title: Deal ID
dealId.description: Deal Desk deal ID, for example ACME-Q4. Optional when Opportunity Id is given.

discountPercent.title: Discount Percent
discountPercent.description: Requested discount in percent, for example 20 for 20%.

opportunityId.title: Opportunity Id
opportunityId.description: Salesforce Id of the Opportunity to review. Its Deal Desk Deal ID is used when Deal ID is empty, and the decision is saved on it.
